entries.summary: Fixed a new Trainer's Starter Pokémon never getting Liked/Disliked flavours, and backfilled it for every existing Pokémon missing them.

GMs can now add custom **Pokémon** species (with a Custom hub, reusable species templates, and creation-time Move/Passive picks), **Items** (including duplicating an existing item as a template), **Afflictions**, **Moves**, **Passives**, **Item Categories**, **Proficiencies**, **Trainer Skills**, and **Types** — all scoped to their own Campaign
GMs can now exclude specific global Pokédex entries from their Campaign's world
GMs can now customize EXP and LP leveling.
GMs can set automatic EXP and LP gains (or losses) with certain triggers.
GMs can now customize their Campaign's Shiny rate
EXP, LP and EV's are homebrew systems from the creator of this tool. They are now turned 'Off' by default on new campaigns. They can be turned on by the GM.
The reference data for the Pokedex is now moved to a Campaign scope and will include homebrew data.
Consolidated every Campaign setting into one Customization menu, with a consistent layout across sections
Added an Encounters shortcut to the Sidebar for bookmarked Campaigns
Fixed applying an Affliction to an unassigned pool Pokémon failing
Fixed several Moves and Passives having an incorrect level-learned value from a data-import quirk (some usable far earlier than intended, e.g. Tropius's Leaf Storm at level 1 instead of 61)
Removed a few duplicate/erroneous global Pokédex entries
Added a persisted combat Encounter tracker: group Trainers/Pokémon and enemy/Wild Pokémon into one resumable fight with tracked turn order.
Added attack resolution to Encounters: roll to hit and apply damage to a target, right from the fight.
Trainers can now see and use their own Moves, Features, and Items from within an Encounter.
The Ace trainer's "Affirmation" Feature now actually grants temporary HP on a knockout or critical hit.
Researchers with "Walking encyclopedia" now always see full opponent Pokémon info in an Encounter, even before scanning them.
Added Pokémon types to the Encounter's initiative tracker, shown once identified.
Only the combatant whose turn it is can now act in an Encounter (GMs are still exempt).
A Pokémon's turn in an Encounter now ends automatically once it's used a Move.
Encounter sections that don't apply to you now hide themselves instead of showing disabled.
Clicking a combatant in an Encounter now opens an overlay with their full stats, type, Moves, Features, Bag, and Afflictions instead of navigating away.
A Trainer's Feature description can now be expanded on demand from the Encounter's actions panel.
Added an explanation of how LP/Loyalty and EXP/Leveling actually work, on the Pokémon page.
Class and Origin Skill Talent picks can now be re-chosen after a Trainer is created, on their build page.
Editing a Trainer's Name, Class, Origin, and Base Stats now happens on their build page instead of an inline form, and a Campaign's GM can now also edit that Trainer's Name.
The Trainers overview now has Class, Origin, and Campaign filters.
The Pokémon overview now has Owned/Wild and Campaign filters, a Trainer-name search, and Type/Campaign badges on each card.
NPCs now show up on the Trainers overview, in their own "Your NPCs" section, instead of only under the campaign's own NPC page.
Adding a Trainer to a Campaign you GM (at creation or by reassignment) now defaults it to an NPC, with a checkbox to override for your own player character.
Fixed the Dashboard's Trainer count not including NPCs.
Fixed "Continue to starter Pokémon" giving an error for a Trainer created directly into a Campaign.
Fixed deleting an NPC from the Trainers overview sending you to that NPC's Campaign page instead of keeping you on the list.
Move damage now correctly drops to just the stat modifier (no dice) instead of understating the penalty when Effectiveness removes every die.
Trainers can now breed two eligible Pokémon together on a dedicated screen to try to produce an Egg.
Players can now start hatching an owned Egg, track its progress through Sleep actions, and hatch it into a real Pokémon once ready.
Breeders now get to permanently boost one stat of a Pokémon they just hatched, with a preview of the new totals before confirming.
Players can now cancel an in-progress Egg hatch, with a warning, and get the Egg back in their Bag to start over.
GMs and Trainer owners can now directly edit a Trainer's core stats after creation.
The Unexpected Hatch coin-flip toggle was restyled to match the app's other checkbox buttons, with a clearer label.
Trainers with Egg Finder now get a clear instruction to roll three times and use their best result.
Nearly all breedable species across the whole Pokédex now have correct Egg Group data, so far more Pokémon can actually be bred.
The Breeding screen now only shows Pokémon that could actually pair with your first pick.
Searching the item Catalog or Inventory for common nicknames (like "Pokeball") now finds the matching item.
The Inventory now has a search box.
Changelog releases can now carry a name, like this one.
Bred Eggs from an evolved parent (like Charizard) now correctly produce a base-form Egg (Charmander) instead of an evolved one.
Pokémon evolution buttons and the GM's evolution-chain picker now actually work instead of silently showing nothing.
Wartortle and Wigglytuff each now exist as a single, complete Pokédex entry instead of a correct/misspelled duplicate pair.
Changing a Trainer's background now properly clears out-of-date bonus Talent picks tied to the old background.
Move damage now correctly reflects type effectiveness and immunities again instead of always showing the base amount.
Solo (non-campaign) Trainers can now use "Grant a Move" on their own Pokémon without hitting an error.
A GM can now override an individual Pokémon's base stats.
A GM can now teach a Pokémon a Move it wouldn't normally be eligible to learn.
Added a self-service "Forgot password" flow.
Filled in Size, Weight, Diet, Habitat, and Move Proficiencies for more Legendary and Mythical Pokémon.
Added this in-app Changelog page, updated with each release.
Temporary HP can now actually be granted and tracked, instead of always showing 0.
Players can now add a Pokémon to their campaign's shared pool for the GM to assign to a Trainer.
Implemented the Raring to go Origin's stat bonus and extra Skill Talent picks.
Trainer Features with limited daily uses now show per-use checkboxes, matching Pokémon Moves.
Reorganized the Pokémon detail page's header and Info section for readability.
Fixed players seeing GM-only NPCs in the "Gift to..." picker.
Fixed some Pokémon being able to learn high-level Stat Passives far too early.
Fixed several real Pokémon Abilities being miscategorized as manually-chosen Stat Passives.
Fixed Skill Talent picks not being editable when re-resolving a Subclass, and added a way to change Class directly from the Class Builder.
Fixed the Moves "Against" type picker being unreadable in dark mode.
The "Continue to starter Pokémon" link on a Trainer's build page now hides itself once that Trainer already has one.
Fixed Advanced Class milestones not triggering, broken since an Aug 10 feature rename.
The app's version number is now shown on the Settings page.
Set up automatic build publishing for the app, the first step toward running it on a dedicated live server.
The GM is now warned before an action would overwrite a Trainer's own build choices.
Cleaned up a name collision on Intimidate and some duplicate Stat Passive seed data.
Added campaign-scoped pages for Trainers, NPCs, and Wild Pokémon.
Added personal Trainer/Pokémon ownership permissions.
Search across your Pokémon overview.
Added the PC system for storing a Trainer's Pokémon.
Added a Trainer inventory (Bag) system.
Added a persistent section-navigation sidebar.
Added a Settings page with light/dark theme support.
Filled out the Pokédex/data reference.
Implemented full type effectiveness (super-effective / not-very-effective) calculations.
Added type immunities.
Added an opponent type selector for quick effectiveness checks.
Added the Afflictions system (Burned, Poisoned, Paralyzed, and more).
Added Pokémon Evolution.
Added an LP-based Loyalty editor
Added Talents.
Added Favored Stats.
Tagged moves with the Proficiencies they require.
Choose which move a TM teaches.
Added a workflow to relearn previously-forgotten moves.
Gift a Pokémon from one Trainer to another.
Filled out the Items catalog.
Added Pokémon Likes and Dislikes.
Change your username and password from Settings.
Added Bookmarks, for quick links to your favorite Campaigns, Trainers, and Pokémon.
Live search filters across the Pokédex and other lists.
Campaigns can have a GM-editable name and description.
